text_block_list.text: I spotted Tokai Teio crouching behind the school building and went over to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I haven't been able to see the President at all lately!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even though I go to the student council room every day,
she's aaaalways off somewhere else, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's so much I want to talk about, though...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I know you're busy, but still... *sigh* I wonder when we'll be able to see each other..."

Not being able to see Symboli Rudolf seems to be causing her quite a lot of stress.
Tokai Teio let out a deep sigh.
